import unittest

from shelf.load import load_csv
from shelf.report import low_stock

"""shelfkit's own CSV loader: sku,name,qty,reorder_at.

An empty qty cell means the item has not been counted yet and is kept as None,
so the report can tell "not counted" (never reported) from 0 (always reported).

The vendored shelf/load.py collapses an empty qty to 0 and is overwritten on
every stock-sync sync, so shelfkit loads through this module instead.
"""
import csv
import io

from shelf.model import Item

DEFAULT_REORDER_AT = 5


def load_csv(text):
    items = []
    for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)):
        qty = row["qty"].strip()
        reorder_at = row["reorder_at"].strip()
        items.append(
            Item(
                row["sku"],
                row["name"],
                int(qty) if qty else None,
                int(reorder_at) if reorder_at else DEFAULT_REORDER_AT,
            )
        )
    return items
